one_line: A skilled royal mint master of the Pandya kingdom, overseeing the striking of fish-emblem coins for trade across South India and Sri Lanka.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build from hands-on metalwork
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Dravidian complexion, straight nose, sharp observant eyes, faint metal-burn marks on forearms, default expression calm and focused as if judging a coin’s quality
appearance.hair: thick black hair tied into a short, neat topknot at the crown, sides smoothly combed back; simple narrow gold forehead band (thin strip) resting above the eyebrows, no turban or helmet
appearance.costume: era-accurate South Indian craftsman’s attire: an ankle-length off-white cotton veshti/dhoti wrapped snugly and pleated at the front, a fitted short-sleeved upper cloth in muted indigo cotton reaching just below the waist, and a light, tawny-brown cotton angavastram (shawl) draped over the left shoulder and across the chest; bronze armlets on both upper arms, simple gold studs in ears, and a practical leather belt at the waist holding small tools; bare feet in sturdy dark leather sandals suitable for a workshop floor.
appearance.signature: a heavy, rectangular bronze coin-die block engraved with a stylized twin-fish emblem, clasped in his left hand, with a short-handled iron striking hammer resting in his right hand.

ref_desc: A mid-30s Pandya mint master with medium-brown skin, black topknot hair and gold forehead band, wearing an off-white dhoti, indigo upper cloth and tawny shawl, bronze armlets and leather belt, holding a bronze twin-fish coin die and iron hammer in an indigo-tawny palette.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style character of a mid-30s male Pandya mint master from South India: medium-brown skin, oval face, calm focused eyes, thick black hair tied in a neat topknot with a thin gold forehead band. He wears an ankle-length off-white cotton dhoti wrapped and pleated, a fitted indigo short-sleeved upper cloth, and a tawny-brown cotton shawl draped over his left shoulder and across his chest. Bronze armlets sit on both upper arms, simple gold studs in his ears, and a practical dark leather belt at his waist holds small metalworking tools. His feet are in sturdy dark leather sandals. In his left hand he firmly holds a heavy rectangular bronze coin-die block engraved with a stylized twin-fish emblem, and in his right hand rests a short-handled iron striking hammer. Show him front-facing, three-quarter, and back views, clearly displaying face, topknot, gold band, garments, jewellery, belt, sandals, and the bronze die and hammer, with colours dominated by indigo, off-white, tawny brown, bronze and dark leather brown.
